text: Morning Marisol, the Sysco order got shorted on the flat parsley and two cases of shallots. I put in a credit request in Trellis but can you check the dock receipt before you sign anything else for them today.
Harbor Prep is live on the commissary side now. Please use the new prep sheet for the braise and the veal stock, not the old binder. Gus will walk you through the labels.
Lunch covered? I got the sandwiches from the place on Fulton. Come grab one before the rush, we can do the walk-in count after.
Ghost pars for the Lantern patio are still wrong. Shaved fennel is running at triple what we sold last week, so I cut the ghost par to 4 quarts until the weather holds.
Thanks for covering Tuesday, seriously. I owe you one. Let me know which shift you want back and I will get it on the board by Friday.
Sundown sheet is in the shared drive under the week of the 3rd. Tomasz needs the dish par updated before close, the glassware count is off again.
Dwayne, the reach-in by the pass is reading 46 degrees again. Pull the thermometer and check the door gasket before you pull anything from it. Log it on the temp sheet.
Can you swing by the bakery and ask Priya if the laminated dough is ready for Saturday? Catering wants twelve trays and I do not want to scramble.
Not sure the new Toast ticket printer is routing to expo correctly. The grill tickets are printing at the bar. Can you check the config before lunch service?
Brinebox is cloudy again. Dump it and rebuild with the two-percent mix, do not just top it off. Write the date on the lid with the marker, not the sticky tag.
Thanks Odell, the tallyback looks clean for the week. Only the sumac is off by a half jar, probably a double count from the Tuesday receiving. Fix it when you can.
Saltbox catering inquiry came in through the site form, forty covers for a Sunday brunch in March. I need a quote by Thursday, so ping me when you have the numbers.
Quick question. Does anyone know where the bench scraper went? I think Lena took it to the commissary prep station and never brought it back.
Walk-in reorganization is done on the left side. Everything is FIFO now with the date tags facing out. Right side is still a mess, please do not stack the cream on top of the stock.
Heads up that the health inspector is scheduled for the 14th, unannounced probably. Make sure the cooling log is current on every batch from the last two days.
Brightline counts are due in the system by 9. Last week nobody entered the dry goods, so the variance report looked insane. Please finish the bin counts tonight.
Shift swap approved. Brianna takes the Saturday close and you get Monday off. I already updated the schedule in Homebase, you just need to confirm it on your phone.
The mother sauce for the house gravy is turning sour on the cold side. We binned four quarts. Tell Marisol before she starts the next batch so she checks the cooling time.
Do you want the leftover short rib on family meal or should we put it toward the Lantern test? Let me know before the crew breaks at four.
Tomasz, the chemical rack by the three-comp sink is missing the sanitizer test strips again. Put in a reorder today, the quat is at fifty percent and the strips are gone.
Make sure the prep list for the Saltbox order gets printed and taped to the commissary door. Priya and Gus both need a copy, and nobody gets to change the yield on the sheet.
Happy birthday to Lena from the whole line. Sheet cake is in the back fridge, do not let Dwayne eat the whole thing before the card goes around.
Reminder that the new Trellis ordering window closes at 2 pm on Thursdays. If the produce is not in by then it rolls to the following Monday, which kills the special.
Fryer oil on station three is at the discard point, I already tested it with the TPM strips. Bring the 35-pound jug from the back and change it before dinner prep.
Can you cover the expo pass Friday? Gus is out for the dentist and Dwayne cannot run the board by himself during the Lantern soft open. Call me if the math does not work.
The new 86 board is up on the pass, but it still is not synced with the POS. Anything we 86 in Toast needs to get written on the whiteboard too for now.
Pulled the pork came out dry because the cook time was off by forty minutes on the Cambro. Log it on the waste sheet with the actual weight so Marisol can see the number.
Good morning. The walk-in door alarm chirped twice overnight, probably the gasket again. I called the refrigeration guy and he can come by Wednesday afternoon.
Hey, anybody seen the good tongs? The ones with the blue tape. We have three new cooks starting and I want them using the correct set during the Harbor Prep training.
Par levels for the commissary bread got bumped up for the Saltbox weekend. Priya asked for 60 buns instead of 40, so update the ghost par before the Thursday order goes in.
Thanks for the heads up about the lowboy. It was the thermostat, not the compressor, so Tomasz is ordering the part and we should be good by Monday.
Schedule for next week is posted. Lena is on prep Monday through Wednesday, Odell is on dish, and I need one more person for the Friday brunch shift. Let me know asap.
Lantern patio menu draft is in the shared drive. I cut the crudo and added a grilled peach salad with the whipped feta, please give me honest feedback by tonight.
Did you finish the cooling log for the bone broth? I need it signed before the inspector shows up, and the time on the first reading looks wrong to me.
Can someone grab a case of the 000 flour from the Sysco truck? The dock guy left it at the back door and we are out in the bake station.
Priya, the laminated dough counts for Saltbox are in the tallyback. We need 12 trays of croissant blanks, not 10, and make sure they get proofed by six tomorrow morning.
Quick reminder that the new tip-out split starts this Friday. Management sheet is going to show it so please double check your hours before you clock out for the night.
Yo Dwayne, the saute pan on station two has a warp, toss it in the pile for the scrap guy and grab the spare from the basement. Do not use it on the Harbor Prep braise.
Kitchen is closed Monday for the deep clean. Everyone needs to be in by 8 and the hood filters go out to the vendor that afternoon. Bring gloves, the old ones are gone.
I finally got the ghost pars working in Trellis after a two-hour call with support. The auto-order triggers when the on-hand drops below par, so stop typing those numbers by hand.
The health inspection passed with two minor notes, both about the wiping cloths at the flat-top. Tomasz, can you put a bucket at every station with the right quat concentration.
Sorry for the late note. The smoked trout came in short on the Saltbox order and I had to swap in the cured salmon, which Odell already flagged as a menu change.
Thanks everyone for pushing through the Lantern soft open. Covers were around 140 and the ticket times stayed under twelve minutes, which is huge for a first night.
Do you have a spare thermometer probe for the lowboy? The one we have reads three degrees high, and I do not trust it for the cooling logs we have to send tomorrow.
Priya wants the candied pecans moved to the Harbor Prep sheet with the oven time updated. Her hour estimate is already on the sheet, please just confirm the yield before Friday.
Quick check on the par for lemons, we went through 18 cases last week which is way over. Did the Lantern drinks menu change or did someone over-juice on the Tuesday prep?
Odell had a family thing this morning so I covered dish. Could you check his station and sign his closing checklist before you leave? I already initialed the chemicals part.
Walk-in is done on the right side too. The cream is now on the top shelf with the label facing front, the stock is on the bottom, and the raw protein is on the lowest shelf.
Got the chef's note on the new gratin, it needs a bit more salt and the top has to brown faster. Please hold it in the bain for ten minutes before you run the next tray.
Can we move the Thursday staff meeting to 3? Gus has a delivery window at two and I want the Trellis walkthrough done before the dinner push. Let me know if that works.
Heads up that the sani bucket at the grill is dropping below 200 ppm by late afternoon. Refresh it at the two-hour mark and log the reading on the temp sheet.
I signed the Sysco credit slip for the damaged cases of tomatoes. Bring the paper copy to the office on Monday so accounting can match it to the invoice.
Good work tonight on the walk-in clean-out. We pitched about 30 pounds of expired dairy and the par for cream should drop by a case now that we have a real count.
New server starts Monday, her name is Ines. Please show her the expo system and the Toast flow before she touches the pass, and keep her off the 86 board until she gets it.
Did anyone move the fish from the reach-in by the saute line? Tracking the log for the salmon and I cannot find the tag. If it went to the walk-in let me know right now.
Final Saltbox numbers are in. Forty-two covers, two vegan substitutions, one gluten-free swap on the brioche. Marisol is building the prep list and I will send it out tonight.
Tomasz, the glassware count is still off by six rocks glasses. Check the back bar tub and the Lantern patio storage, I think a case went out with the patio furniture delivery.
Reminder that I am off Thursday and Friday. Marisol has the keys and the alarm code, and Gus is running the expo. Text me only if the walk-in alarm goes off for real.
Really proud of the crew this week. We ran three big events, the Saltbox brunch, the Lantern soft open, and the Harbor Prep training, without a single missed ticket.
Last note before the holiday. Please make sure every station has a labeled cooler sheet and the sundown checklist is signed. Happy Thanksgiving to everyone, see you Monday.
